name: Northern Sands Hotel
accommodation: 12 en-suite rooms, all on the first floor
suitableFor: Couples and groups wanting a hotel with food all day
dogs: No pets inside; dogs welcome in the beer garden
beachAccess: In Dunnet village beside the bay's two-mile beach
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, two bars, full Scottish breakfast, free Wi-Fi, smart TVs
overview: Northern Sands is a hotel in Dunnet village, beside the two-mile sweep of Dunnet Bay and about four miles from Dunnet Head. It has 12 en-suite rooms on the first floor, a restaurant serving food all year and two bars. Dunnet Bay Distillers is next door.
surfTripFit: A hot meal and a bar right by the beach make it an easy base, though dogs can't stay inside.
